description: List every Alexandria data provider, or every provider in one category, in a single call; with limit, only the first providers in catalogue order. Used by the Firecrawl sidebar; free, and it executes no provider. Use alexandria_library_search to browse the catalogue or read contracts (/library/<category>/<provider>/<capability>.md).

limit.description: Return only the first providers, in one catalogue page.

name: firecrawl_provider_directory
